name: BroadSheet
summary: Term report cards that write themselves.
description: A multi-school web platform for Nigerian schools. Teachers enter scores across the term and BroadSheet generates each student's report card automatically. Parents and students check results online instead of waiting for paper.

name: James — Engineer Portfolio
summary: A portfolio the client edits himself.
description: A portfolio for a mechanical and electrical engineer, with a built-in admin panel. The client manages projects, blog posts, his CV and profile from /admin. No developer is needed after launch. Includes a Markdown editor with live preview, image uploads and a contact form backed by the database.

name: De Lady's Beauty World
summary: A beauty store with an AI routine maker.
description: The online store for De Lady's Beauty World, a skincare and beauty retailer. Customers shop, pay securely through KoraPay and use an AI routine maker that suggests a skincare routine for their skin. Behind it is an installable admin app for managing products and orders. It sends push alerts to the owner's phone the moment an order comes in, even when the panel is closed.

name: Mimi Beauty Essentials
description: The live online store for Mimi Beauty Essentials, a cosmetics retailer delivering across Nigeria. Product catalogue, search, wishlist, customer accounts and cart, with validated checkout forms and a custom domain. Built and maintained as the brand's front-end developer.

name: Lumière
description: A full-stack storefront for a clean beauty and skincare brand, with a real database, Google sign-in, a cart that persists between visits and two ways to pay: Paystack online, or cash on delivery for local customers in Warri.

name: Fabulous Barbershop
description: A website for a barbershop in Garden City, Port Harcourt. It covers the services menu with prices, a gallery and reviews, and one-tap booking through WhatsApp. Customers can book from their phone in a few seconds.

name: SchoolPortal
description: A Java Servlet application for running a school. It has role-based logins for teachers and students, BCrypt password hashing, protection against session fixation, class enrolment on first login and a teacher dashboard of enrolled students.

name: Hebron Hills International School
description: A multi-page website for a nursery-to-secondary school in Port Harcourt. It is built around admissions: key figures, the school's story, why parents choose it and a clear Apply Now path on every page.

name: M&J Stitches
description: A multi-page site for M&J Stitches, a bespoke menswear brand in Port Harcourt making suits, senators, kaftans and native wear to order. Collections are browsed through swipeable galleries, and each piece has its own detail page.

name: Ledgerly
description: A personal finance dashboard for tracking income, spending and balances, with clear charts. Data flows through Context and hooks, and the layout holds up from phone to widescreen.

name: Torgist — Ghost Thread
description: Anonymous storytelling for Gen Z. You write, and the app slices your text into cards, reads the emotional energy of each one and gives it a colour, gradient and aura. Then you share it or let it vanish. No usernames, no followers, just the story.

name: Finovo
description: A landing page for a finance product, with a clean layout, a responsive grid and smooth entrance animations.
